independent_group.note: Nineteen Angular jobs, six package jobs and API documentation. This single chore-branch observation does not establish a representative median or test/coverage parity; the rest of the workflow was still running when observed.

independent_test_result_comparison.note: Per-job CircleCI source, classname, name and result tuples match with multiplicity across different revisions. Empty test-result lists do not establish discovery parity; reported identities cannot establish complete discovery or coverage equivalence.

arm64_pilot.note: Sequential native ARM64 builds; PDF followed runtime and reused builder cache. Builds include export/loading. Smoke checks did not exercise portal HTTP startup or the application PDF endpoint. Initial buildx removal failed for an unknown reason; subsequent cleanup succeeded. Credits, peak memory, publication and matched parallel builds were not measured.

other_image_test_result_comparison.note: Per-job CircleCI test-result multisets of source, classname, name and result match with multiplicity across different revisions. Reported identities do not establish complete discovery, coverage or behavioral equivalence.

final_workflow.note: The gate excludes the non-gating Mocha baseline. Required checks exceeded the 720-second target. This chore-branch observation does not establish representative warm or publication performance.

matched_mocha_comparison.note: Recorded source tree and image attestations match. Strict policy fails for count decreases, including positive-to-positive changes; no covered identity became uncovered. Skipped testcase identities, source-map provenance, executed generated bytes and discovery completeness remain unverified. This does not establish coverage equivalence.

solr_fixture_probe.note: Separate Node test step; not included in Mocha JUnit counts. Real Solr indexing test also reported success in both jobs.
